question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word: Placatory
solution: The correct answer is: **Provocative**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Placatory"** means intended to calm, pacify, or appease someone to avoid conflict. (शांत कराने वाला/मनाने वाला) • **Example:** She spoke in a placatory tone to prevent an argument. • **"Provocative"** means causing anger, irritation, or strong reaction; something that provokes. (उकसाने वाला/भड़काने वाला) • **Example:** His provocative comments triggered a heated debate. • Hence, the opposite of **"Placatory"** is **"Provocative"** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Provocative**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and examples: • **Conciliatory** (समझौता कराने वाला / शांतिदायक): Intended to pacify or make peace. • **Example:** The manager adopted a conciliatory approach to resolve the dispute. • **Soothing** (शांतिदायक / आराम देने वाला): Having a calming or comforting effect. • **Example:** The soothing music helped her relax after a long day. • **Appeasing** (मनाने वाला / शांत कराने वाला): Trying to calm someone by giving in to their demands. • **Example:** He used an appeasing gesture to settle the argument. 36:T945, The correct answer is: **Sincere**.
